scripts.text:
[Elin]
^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
^3355FF等一下！你現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將一些物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hello~!
Heh heh, you're a boy, so you probably don't like dolls, right? Well, I like dolls very very much!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你好呀~！
嘿嘿，你是男孩子，大概不喜歡娃娃吧？不過我超級超級喜歡娃娃！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hi hi~! Oh, oh, do you like dolls? I really really like dolls... Hee Hee~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗨嗨~！哦，哦，你喜歡娃娃嗎？我真的超級超級喜歡娃娃...嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
You know, I really really want a new doll! I hope my daddy will give me one on my birthday...!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你知道嗎，我真的很想要一個新娃娃！希望爸爸會在生日那天送我一個...！

scripts.text: Um, I hope your daddy gives you one too.
scripts.translation: 嗯，希望爸爸也送你一個。

scripts.text: How about I give you one now?
scripts.translation: 要不我現在就送你一個？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Yeah, I'm hoping
he gives me a Yoyo
doll. They're so cute!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
對，我希望
他送我一隻
溜溜猴娃娃。
它們好可愛！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Maybe you should put some of your stuff away first, you look like you're carrying too much, hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
也許你應該先把一些東西收起來，看起來你攜帶的東西太多了，嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Do you always carry so much with you? Put some of your things away first, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你總是攜帶這麼多東西嗎？先把一些東西收起來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Oh my goodness!
Really? You're
such a sweetie~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
天哪！
真的嗎？
你真好~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Will you really?
You're gonna give
me a doll? Yaaaay~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
真的嗎？
你要送我
一個娃娃？耶~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
What kind of doll are you going to give me? Are you really gonna give me one?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你要送我什麼娃娃？你真的要送我一個嗎？

scripts.text: Poring Doll
scripts.translation: 波利娃娃

scripts.text: Chonchon Doll
scripts.translation: 蒼蠅娃娃

scripts.text: Puppet
scripts.translation: 木偶

scripts.text: Rocker Doll
scripts.translation: 搖滾蝗蟲娃娃

scripts.text: Spore Doll
scripts.translation: 魔菇娃娃

scripts.text: Osiris Doll
scripts.translation: 俄塞里斯娃娃

scripts.text: Baphomet Doll
scripts.translation: 巴風特娃娃

scripts.text: Raccoon Doll
scripts.translation: 浣熊娃娃

scripts.text: Yoyo Doll
scripts.translation: 溜溜猴娃娃

scripts.text: I'm as adorable as a doll.
scripts.translation: 我像娃娃一樣可愛。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Aww...
I have a lot
of Poring dolls...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...
我有好多波利娃娃...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But since a cute boy is giving it to me, I'll happily take it! Hee hee, soft and fluffy Poring doll~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
不過既然可愛的男孩送給我，我就開心地收下啦！嘻嘻，軟綿綿的波利娃娃~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But since a nice girl is giving it to me, I'll take it! Hee he, soft and fluffy Poring doll~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
不過既然漂亮的女孩送給我，我就收下啦！嘻嘻，軟綿綿的波利娃娃~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Ooh, let me give you something as a little thank you. You see, I hid some candy so I can eat it without telling mommy.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哦，讓我給你點東西作為小小的感謝。你看，我藏了一些糖果，這樣我就可以偷偷吃，不用告訴媽媽了。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I don't know if you're too old to like candy, but I guess it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我不知道你是不是年紀太大不喜歡糖果了，不過應該沒關係吧。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
So, try not to eat too much, okay? Otherwise, you might get in trouble!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
所以，儘量別吃太多，好嗎？不然可能會惹上麻煩的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Thank you
so much for
the Poring doll!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
非常感謝
你送的波利娃娃！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Aww...?
Were you only teasing me?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...？
你只是在逗我玩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Aww...
You're not making fun of me are you?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...
你是在捉弄我吧？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I guess you forgot it somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我想你是把它忘在什麼地方了吧...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Agh--!
A Ch-Ch, Chonchon doll?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊--！
一一隻蒼蠅娃娃？！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But since... You're... Such a nice guy... I better take it...!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
但是既然...你...是個好人...我還是收下吧...！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But since... Since it's a gift... I guess I'll take it...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
但是既然...既然是禮物...我就收下吧...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Mmm~
Let me give you
something in return...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯~
讓我給你點東西作為回禮...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
If you eat too much, your teeth will start to rot... at least, that's what Mommy says.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
吃太多的話牙齒會爛掉的...至少媽媽是這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
And..
Uh...
Thank you
for the doll?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
還有..
那個...
謝謝
你的娃娃？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Chonchon dolls are ugly anyways, but you still lied to me! How can you be so mean?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
蒼蠅娃娃本來就醜，但你居然騙我！你怎麼能這麼壞？！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Waaaaaaaaah~~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Wow...!
It looks like a bunny!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇...！
看起來像只兔子！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I really like this Puppet~ Heh hehe! Thank you so much~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我真的很喜歡這個布偶~ 嘿嘿！太感謝你了~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Ooh ooh!
I have something
for you too!
Um, where
did it... Ah!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哦哦！
我也有東西
要給你！
嗯，放在哪
了...啊！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Here it is! It's some of the candy Santa gave me. Go ahead and try some! Oh, and thank you so much for the doll!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
找到了！這是聖誕老人給我的糖果。快嚐嚐吧！哦，還有，非常感謝你送我的娃娃！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Awww, you were only kidding? W-W-Why are you teasing me like that?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀，你只是開玩笑？為...為什麼你要這樣捉弄我？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Waaaaaaaaah~~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Ooh! Rocker Doll!
It's the Rocker that likes singing and dancing! I don't like grasshoppers, but I like this because it's cute~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哦！搖滾蝗蟲娃娃！
就是那個喜歡唱歌跳舞的蝗蟲！我不喜歡蝗蟲，但我覺得這個很可愛~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hmmm, I should give you something too, huh? Let's see, I have what my grandpa gave me...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯嗯，我也應該給你點東西，對吧？讓我看看，我有爺爺給我的...東西...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Here you go! We have a lot of this at home, so I'll give it to you, okay? Oh, and thank you so much for the doll~ I love cute dolls!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
給你！家裡有很多這個，所以給你一些，好嗎？哦，還有，非常感謝你送我的娃娃~ 我喜歡可愛的娃娃！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Awww...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
You don't
really have a doll...?
I was so excited about it, too...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你其實
沒有娃娃...？
我也很期待呢...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
It's a mushroom?
Ewwwwwwwww, yucky!
Mommy made me eat
mushrooms today, too...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
是蘑菇？
嘔，好惡心！
媽媽今天也逼我吃蘑菇了...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
But this doll is cute, so I'll take it. But I'm still not gonna eat mushrooms! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
不過這個娃娃很可愛，我就收下吧。但我還是不吃蘑菇！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hehe~ My mommy made this! It's really yummy. I love cookies, too. So try it, you'll like it! Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿~ 這是我媽媽做的！真的很好吃。我也喜歡餅乾。快嚐嚐，你會喜歡的！嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Thanks for
the doll! I'll
take good care of it!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
謝謝
你的娃娃！我會
好好照顧它的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Eh...?
You don't
have a doll?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
誒...？
你沒有
娃娃？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Awww...
It's not nice
to tease people
like that. ^666666*Sniff, sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...
這樣捉弄人
是不對的。^666666*吸鼻子，吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Ahhhhh!
What is this
thing?! It's so scary!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊啊啊！
這是什麼
東西？！好可怕！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I've never seen a doll like this before. Where it's from? Hmm? Since I've never seen this kind of doll before, I'm gonna show it to my daddy, too. Hehe~! He'll be surprised!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我從沒見過這樣的娃娃。它是從哪裡來的？嗯？既然我從沒見過這種娃娃，我要把它給爸爸看看。嘿嘿~！他一定會很驚訝的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Here, since you gave me such a nicely made doll, I better give you something good too.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
給你，既然你送了我這麼精緻的娃娃，我也應該給你點好東西。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I found it when I secretly went to the forest. I took it because it has pretty colors!
Since there's two, you can share it with your girlfriend. Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
這是我偷偷去普勒斯特森林時找到的。因為顏色很漂亮，我就拿回來了！
既然有兩個，你可以和你的女朋友分享哦。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I found it when I secretly went to the forest. I took it because it has pretty colors!
Since there's two, you can share it with your boyfriend. Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
這是我偷偷去普勒斯特森林時找到的。因為顏色很漂亮，我就拿回來了！
既然有兩個，你可以和你的男朋友分享哦。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Awww...
Why do you have
to make fun of me?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎呀...
為什麼要
捉弄我呀？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Huh?
It's a little goat...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
咦？
是一隻小山羊...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
It's so weird. It's cute but it's also scary at the same time. Well, since you gave me a pretty doll, I wanna give you something, too.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好奇怪。雖然很可愛，但同時也讓人有點害怕。不過，既然你送了我這麼漂亮的娃娃，我也想送你點東西。

scripts.text:
[Elin]
My daddy gave me this when I was really sick. I'm not sick anymore so you can use it when you need to. Hehehe~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
這是我生病時爸爸給我的。我現在已經好了，所以你需要的時候可以用。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hee hee~
Thank you for
the doll. I won't lose it!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿~
謝謝你的娃娃。
我不會弄丟它的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
You big liar! Why are you pretending to be nice?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你這個大騙子！為什麼要假裝對我好？！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hehe, it's a
raccoon doll.
It's very very cute~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿，這是一個
狸貓娃娃。
非常非常可愛~

scripts.text:
[Elin]
I don't like
Smokies in real life,
but this doll is nice!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我不喜歡
現實中的狸貓，
但這個娃娃很不錯！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Here, let me give you some cake my grandma made. It's really yummy. I don't know if you like sweets or not, but it's really good! Please try some!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
給你，嚐嚐我老奶奶做的蛋糕。真的很好吃。我不知道你喜不喜歡甜食，但它真的很好吃！請嚐嚐吧！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hee hee~
Thanks for the doll.
I'm gonna keep it
in my room!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿~
謝謝你的娃娃。
我要把它
放在我的房間裡！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hey! How come you have to say things like that? Are you making fun of me?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿！
為什麼你要說這種話？你是在捉弄我嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Woooooooow~!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇哦哦哦哦~！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
A Yoyo doll! It's so pretty! You're really gonna give it to me?! Yay! Thank you so much! I really like it! Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
溜溜猴娃娃！好漂亮！你真的要給我嗎？！太好了！非常感謝！我真的好喜歡！嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Since you gave
me such a pretty doll,
I wanna give you
something, too!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
既然你送了我
這麼漂亮的娃娃，
我也想送你
點東西！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
My daddy picked it up on his way to another town. It looks like some kind of seed. I tried planting it in front of our house but it won't grow. Do you want to try?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
這是爸爸去別的城鎮路上撿到的。看起來像某種種子。我試著把它種在我們家門前，但它長不出來。你想試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hehe~
Thanks for
the doll. I'll hug
it before I go
to sleep!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿~
謝謝你的娃娃。
我睡覺前
會抱著它的！

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Hey...
How come you're making fun of me?!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿...
為什麼你要捉弄我？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm as adorable as a doll...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我像娃娃一樣可愛...

scripts.text:
[Elin]
Whaaaaaaaaaaat...?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哇啊啊啊...？

scripts.text:
[Elin]
^3355FFWhat did^000000
^3355FFyou just say?!^000000

[Grampa]
*Gasp*...
....*Gasp!*
Oh...
Some may say I've lived a full life on wine, women and song...
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
*倒吸一口涼氣*...
....*喘氣！*
噢...
也許有人會說，我這一生都在美酒、女人和歌聲中度過...

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
But my soul still burns with youthful vigor! It's just... This old body can't keep up anymore... *Hack! Wheeeeze~*
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
但我的靈魂依然燃燒著年輕的活力！只是...這副老骨頭再也跟不上了... *咳！呼哧~*

scripts.text: Show him Tiger's Footskin.
scripts.translation: 給他看虎掌。

scripts.text: Exchange it with Boys Cap.
scripts.translation: 用男孩的帽子交換。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
Ohhh~ !!
Is that...?
It is! 
That's Tiger's Footskin!! Even from here I can feel its powers!
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
噢噢~！！
那是...？
沒錯！
那是虎掌！！即使從這裡我也能感受到它的力量！

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
One glance at it can restore your strength, one sniff and your blood boils with vigorous pleasure...
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
看一眼就能恢復體力，聞一下就會熱血沸騰，充滿活力的快感...

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
Just one bite...
Will revive my virility!!!! The Tiger's Footskin~!! Ohhhh! Ohh My God !! Please!!! Please give me that... Please...
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
只要咬一口...
就能讓我重振雄風！！虎掌~！！噢噢！天哪！！求求您了！！請給我那個...求求您...

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
T... Thank you !!
With this I can revive my youthful splendor!! I must eat this thing right away !
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
謝...謝謝您！！
有了這個，我就能重現年輕時的風采了！我必須馬上吃掉它！

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
...
Nope. Still feel OLD.
If anything, I feel even worse. Th-there's this buzzing in my head...
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
...
不行。還是覺得老。
如果說有什麼不同的話，我感覺更糟了。頭...頭裡嗡嗡作響...

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
He...Hey, kid !! W-Wait !
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
嘿...嘿，小孩！！等...等等！

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
Listen well...
You've got to take care of yourself as well as your can. Without your health, one cannot enjoy the pleasures of this mortal realm.
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
聽好了...
你要儘可能照顧好自己。沒有健康，就無法享受這凡塵世間的樂趣。

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
In order to restore my youth, I tried all sorts of things, mostly by hearsay, but nothing worked. In the end, I spent so much zeny on miracle cures, I ended up broke.
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
為了恢復青春，我嘗試了各種各樣的東西，大多是聽別人說的，但都沒用。最後，我花光了所有的Zeny去買那些靈丹妙藥，結果破產了。

scripts.text:
[Grampa]
I've mostly given up on restoring my youth. But there is one hope left... Eating ^3355FFTiger's Footskin^000000, The King of Invigorators!!
scripts.translation:
[爺爺]
我基本上已經放棄恢復青春了。但還剩下一絲希望...吃^3355FF虎掌^000000，活力之王！！

scripts.text:
[Grampa]

[Cherokee]

scripts.translation:

Do you have ^FF3355Evil Horn^000000?

scripts.text: Shut up, Dumbo.

[Tempestra]
Here it is, tee hee~
How about that?
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
給，嘻嘻~
怎麼樣？
喜歡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Once again, thank you for your favour. I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
再次感謝您的惠顧。下次見~

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Oh alright~
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
哦，好的~

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
If by any chance you visit me later, I'd be more than happy to make a hat for you~
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
如果您之後再來找我，我會非常樂意為您製作一頂帽子~

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Well then, see you later~
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
那麼，下次見~

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
I will tell you a secret, because you gave me the Yellow Potion~
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
因為您給了我黃色藥水，所以我要告訴您一個秘密~

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
I'm looking forward seeing you again~~
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
期待再次見到您~~

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Well, the hats I have with me are for my customers. If I use them for myself, I'll have nothing to sell...
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
嗯，我手邊的帽子是賣給顧客的。如果我自己用了，就沒什麼可賣的了...

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
I want to make something special for you because you showed me such kindness, but I don't have anything like that right now.
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
因為您對我這麼好，我想為您做點特別的東西，但我現在手頭沒有合適的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Hmm...
I think I can make a special item from the items you already have.
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
嗯...
我覺得可以用您現有的材料製作一件特別的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
If there are any forged items or slotted items with monster cards, then put them into your Kafra storage.
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
如果您有鍛造過的物品，或者鑲嵌了魔物卡片的物品，請把它們存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Heh heh...
I think I'll make you a Hat of the Sun God~
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
嘿嘿...
我想為您製作一頂太陽神頭盔~

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
See! Here it is!!
Haha, I made this quicker than the speed of light!
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
看！在這裡！！
哈哈，我做得比光速瞬移還快呢！

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
...Or maybe I just gave you the one I already had, and took your items. Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
...或者我只是把早就做好的給您，然後拿走了您的材料。嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Anyway, I justed want to give something really nice to you...
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
總之，我只是想送您一份很棒的禮物...

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Hmm...
^0000FF1 Emblem of the Sun God^000000
^0000FF10 Gold^000000
^0000FF40 Steel^000000
^0000FF50 Coal^000000
^0000FF2 Oridecon^000000

[Tempestra]
If you have these, I can make you my fantastic 'Hat of the Sun God!'
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
如果您有這些材料，我就能為您製作出我引以為傲的“太陽神頭盔”！

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
I just want to make something really special for you, so I won't charge you any zeny to make this hat.
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
我只是想為您做點特別的東西，所以製作這頂帽子不收您任何Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
Umm, I appreciate it but, I guess you just ran out of Yellow Potions?
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
嗯，我很感激，不過...您是不是黃色藥水用完了？

scripts.text:
[Tempestra]
....How rude!
scripts.translation:
[坦佩斯特拉]
....真沒禮貌！

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
What does a man have to do to get a stiff drink around here? I mean, there are absolutely no good bars in Alberta!
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
一個男人要怎麼做才能在這裡喝到烈酒呢？我是說，艾爾貝塔這裡根本沒有像樣的酒吧！

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Well, the alcohol in the pub here is second rate, but I gotta admit, it's got a great atmosphere.
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
嗯，這裡的酒館雖然酒質一般，但我不得不承認，這裡的氛圍很棒。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
In fact, this old man is always there, telling stories about Turtle Island! But we're not sure if he's been there, or if he's just that drunk.
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
事實上，那位老人總是坐在那裡，講著關於海龜島的故事！但我們不確定他是否真的去過那裡，還是隻是喝得太醉了。

scripts.text: Sounds fun~
scripts.translation: 聽起來很有趣~

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Whoa...
Hey, your eyes just lit up right when I said 'Turtle Island!' Hmm, let me try that again.
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
哇...
嘿，我一提到“海龜島”，您的眼睛就亮了起來。嗯，讓我再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
*Ahem*
'Tur-tle
Is-land.'
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
*咳咳*
“海-龜-島。”

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Ah...
You must be an adventurer. It seems like you really wanna learn more about that place, huh?
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
啊...
您一定是位冒險者。看來您真的很想多瞭解那個地方，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Why don't you look around near the pub, and look for that old man? He's usually pretty drunk, and speaks nonsense, but he might have something to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
您不妨去酒館附近轉轉，找找那位老人。他通常喝得爛醉，說話顛三倒四，但也許對您有些話要說。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Oh, and um, I've been in his room before. He leaves some sort of letter lying around the table that has something to do with his Turtle Island stories.
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
哦，對了，我之前去過他的房間。他在桌子上留了一封信，似乎與他關於海龜島的故事有關。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
But if he asks for you to buy him a drink, I wouldn't do it. He's got like, three extra livers or something, so he'll drink you to bankruptcy.
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
但如果他讓您請他喝酒，我勸您別答應。他好像有三顆額外的肝臟，能把您喝到破產。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
Yeah, I guess it's pretty cool listening to his stories. But it would be even cooler if I could hear them in a better drinking establishment.
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
嗯，聽他講故事確實挺有意思的。但如果能在一家更好的酒館裡聽，那就更棒了。

scripts.text:
[Kinsey]
I mean, they don't even serve a 'Boogieman,' much less a 'Cobo.' It's getting harder and harder to find those fine, fine specialty drinks.
scripts.translation:
[金賽]
我是說，他們連“鬼魂”都不賣，更別提“科博”了。那些精緻的高階飲品越來越難找了。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ooog...
So dizzy...
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
噢...
好暈...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
There isn't one decent drinking establishment in all of Alberta! But then again, why did I drink so much? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
整個艾爾貝塔竟然沒有一家像樣的酒館！不過話說回來，我為什麼喝那麼多呢？嗯...

scripts.text: Tell me about Turtle Island
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於海龜島的事

scripts.text: How can I get there?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼去那裡？

scripts.text: Stop talking
scripts.translation: 別說了

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Eh...?
Turtle Island?
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
呃...？
海龜島？

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Well, there's a lot of folklore about that place. Some folk say that there's a mountain of treasure there.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
嗯，關於那個地方有很多傳說。有人說那裡有一座寶藏山。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Others folk say a potion that can prolong your lifespan can be found somewhere in Turtle Island. But nobody really knows for sure.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
還有人說，在海龜島的某個地方能找到一種能延長壽命的藥水。但沒人能確定。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
But I'm sure that Turtle Island does exist, and that something wonderful can be found there.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
但我確信海龜島是真實存在的，而且那裡一定藏著美好的事物。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
But only someone with a good heart that's eager for adventure should be able to go to that kind of place.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
不過，只有心地善良且渴望冒險的人，才能前往那樣的地方。

scripts.text: Tell me more, old man!
scripts.translation: 老傢伙，再多說點！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ha ha ha~!
I like the shine in your eye, my boy! I can see a little bit of myself in those eyes. Yes...
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
哈哈~！
我喜歡你眼中的光芒，孩子！我在你眼中看到了年輕時的自己。是的...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ha ha ha~!
No use hiding the glint in your eyes, my dear! It's adventure you wish for, that much I can tell...
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
哈哈~！
別想掩飾你眼中的光芒，親愛的！你渴望冒險，這一點我看得出來...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Tell me...
Have you heard of a man named ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000? He, and a group of ten other men actually found Turtle Island!
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
告訴我...
你聽說過一位名叫^3355FF約爾納丹·尼利里亞^000000的人嗎？他和另外十個人一起發現了海龜島！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000 was a man of strength and conviction. He and his crew gathered every clue they could about Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
^3355FF約爾納丹·尼利里亞^000000是一位充滿力量與信念的人。他和他的船員收集了所有關於海龜島的線索。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Even after learning all that they could, much of their voyage relied on their hope and faith that the Turtle Island legend was true...
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
即使掌握了所有能找到的資訊，他們的航行依然依賴於對海龜島傳說真實的希望與信任...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
After a long, arduous journey, their efforts were rewarded, and they landed on Turtle Island!
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
經過漫長而艱辛的旅程，他們的努力終於得到了回報，他們登上了海龜島！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
However, it gets more complicated after that. I hear Niliria's crew had great difficulty getting back home for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
不過，之後的事情就變得複雜了。我聽說尼利里亞的船員因為某種原因，很難回到家鄉。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Heh heh...
If you want to learn more, why don't you go to the eastern end of the Alberta port? There's a scholar there that knows more of this story.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
嘿嘿...
如果你想了解更多，不妨去艾爾貝塔港的東邊看看。那裡有一位學者，他更瞭解這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
He could probably shed more light on the subject of Turtle Island's legend.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
他應該能為你解開海龜島傳說的更多謎團。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ah, one more thing! Look around that scholar and you should find his ^3355FFJournal^000000. I promise that it will be an interesting read.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
啊，還有一件事！在那位學者身邊找找，你應該能找到他的^3355FF日記^000000。我保證，那會是一本很有趣的書。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ah...
The fire of youth!
When the winds die, may your dreams fill your sails~ Good luck to you!
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
啊...
青春之火啊！
當風停息時，願你的夢想填滿你的風帆~ 祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Grrrr...!
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
嘎嘎嘎...！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
I may not know much, but I won't talk to anyone motivated solely by greed. Go home!
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
我雖然知道得不多，但我不會跟那些只被貪婪驅動的人說話。回家去吧！

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Well...
If you go to eastern side of the Alberta port, you should find an old ferryboatman.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
嗯...
如果你去艾爾貝塔港的東邊，應該能找到一位老船伕。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
His name is ^3355FFGotanblue^000000. I believe he may know a way to Turtle Island. Heh heh, good luck~
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
他叫^3355FF戈坦布魯^000000。我相信他可能知道去海龜島的路。嘿嘿，祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Turtle Island...?
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
海龜島...？

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
My, that place is difficult to find and even more difficult to travel to. You're sure you want to go? I would love to give you some advice, but I feel so dizzy after drinking so much...
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
哎呀，那個地方很難找到，更難到達。你確定要去嗎？我很想給你一些建議，但喝了這麼多酒，我感覺好暈啊...

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Ho ho ho...
Why don't you talk to a chubby little sailor I know named ^3355FFGotanblue^000000. You can find him loitering on one of the Alberta ports.
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
呵呵呵...
不如去和我認識的一個胖乎乎的小水手聊聊，他叫^3355FF戈坦布魯^000000。你可以在艾爾貝塔港的某個地方找到他。

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Tell him that I sent you, and he may tell you more about Turtle Island. He may even know how to get there~
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
告訴他是我派你來的，他可能會告訴你更多關於海龜島的事。他甚至可能知道怎麼去那裡~

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Well, then...
Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
那麼...
祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Grandpa Turtle]
Oooh...
Even at this age...
I don't understand
how I can drink so much...
scripts.translation:
[烏龜爺爺]
噢...
都這把年紀了...
我都不明白
自己怎麼能喝這麼多...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Heh...
Your eyes...
I can tell you're curious about Turtle Island. I guess you must have been talking to that drunken old man!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
嘿嘿...
你的眼神...
我看出來你對海龜島很好奇。我猜你肯定是跟那個醉鬼老頭聊過吧！

scripts.text: Do you know about Turtle Island?
scripts.translation: 你知道海龜島嗎？

scripts.text: How can I get there?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼去那裡？

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 別說了。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Turtle Island...?
Well, first I think it's fair to warn you that Turtle Island took the lives of my buddies. That's right, I was part of ^3355FFJornadan Niliria^000000's crew.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
海龜島...？
嗯，首先我覺得有必要提醒你，海龜島奪走了我夥伴們的生命。沒錯，我是^3355FF約爾納丹·尼利里亞^000000船隊的一員。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
We wanted to find out if the legends about that island were true, so we left everything behind to learn the truth.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
我們想弄清楚關於那個島嶼的傳說是否屬實，所以我們拋下一切，去探尋真相。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Jornadan Niliria was one of the greatest treasure hunters ever, and he gathered men for his crew from around the globe. I'm proud to say that each member of our crew was the best in his field.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
約爾納丹·尼利里亞是有史以來最偉大的尋寶者之一，他從世界各地招募船員。我很自豪地說，我們船隊的每一位成員都是各自領域的佼佼者。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
I happened to be the best at navigating. I was only twenty, but I was still invited to his team. It was such an honor to be accepted as an equal amongst these great men.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
我恰好是最擅長導航的。當時我才二十歲，卻仍受邀加入他的團隊。能與這些傑出人物平起平坐，真是莫大的榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Anyway, our biggest clue about Turtle Island's location hinted that it was near Alberta, so our voyage began from here.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
總之，關於海龜島位置的最大線索暗示它就在艾爾貝塔附近，所以我們的航行從這裡開始。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
We sailed day and night, drifting for weeks, until one day, we were surrounded by an incredibly thick fog. We had no idea of which direction we were going and the mist wouldn't clear.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
我們日夜航行，漂流了數週。直到有一天，我們被極其濃重的濃霧包圍。我們完全不知道方向，而霧氣遲遲不散。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
But none of us had any regrets and we just kept moving onward. There would be no turning back!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
但我們誰都沒有後悔，只是繼續前行。絕不回頭！

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Finally, a coral reef sudden appeared and we couldn't steer away from it. Our ship was critically damaged. But when the fog cleared, we saw that we had finally arrived at Turtle Island! It was real!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
終於，一片珊瑚礁突然出現，我們無法避開。船身受損嚴重。但當霧氣散去時，我們發現終於到達了海龜島！它是真實存在的！

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
After we made camp on shore and explored the island, we learned something quite remarkable.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
我們在岸上紮營並探索了島嶼，隨後發現了一件相當驚人的事情。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
There was a man who had actually made it to Turtle Island before us. His records, however, never reached Rune-Midgarts. He was a great swordmaster known simply as ^3355FFOne^000000.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
有一位男子曾在我們之前到達過海龜島。然而，他的記錄從未傳回盧恩·米德加茲。他是一位偉大的劍術大師，人們只稱他為^3355FF一^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
According to his records, he had traveled alone to find Turtle Island and made it by himself. But we couldn't find any sign of him anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
根據他的記錄，他是獨自旅行尋找海龜島併成功抵達的。但我們在任何地方都找不到他的蹤跡...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
As we explored Turtle Island further, we learned that not only was it abundant with treasure, but that it also held an item of great interest.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
隨著我們進一步探索海龜島，我們發現那裡不僅寶藏豐富，還有一件令人極其感興趣的物品。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
From the first explorer's record, some kind of amazing ^3355FFjewel fragment^000000 was mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
根據第一位探險者的記錄，提到了一塊驚人的^3355FF寶石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
He had traveled to Turtle Island with the purpose of discovering secrets to the sword arts, and stumbled upon a jewel he claimed was the most beautiful in the world.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
他前往海龜島的目的是探索劍術的秘密，結果偶然發現了一塊他聲稱是世界上最美麗的寶石。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
By the ^3355FFOne^000000's records, we were able to thoroughly explore all to be seen on Turtle Island. However...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
根據^3355FF一^000000的記錄，我們得以徹底探索海龜島上所有可見之處。然而...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Even after months of searching, we could never find a trace of the jewel fragment. Eventually, we had to give up on our search.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
即使搜尋了數月，我們也從未找到寶石碎片的蹤跡。最終，我們不得不放棄尋找。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Finally, we packed our things to leave the island. But then, as we were traveling at sea, we encountered a thick, blinding fog once again.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
最後，我們收拾行裝準備離開島嶼。但就在海上航行時，我們再次遇到了濃重且令人目眩的濃霧。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
We spent a month trying to steer through that mist. When we finally sailed out of that mist, we saw that we had arrived at the other side of Turtle Island!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
我們花了一個月試圖穿過那片迷霧。當我們終於駛出迷霧時，發現我們竟然到達了海龜島的另一側！

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Our spirits were crushed!! We tried again and again to leave that place, and spent nearly a year trying to leave but we kept winding up at Turtle Island's shores.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
我們的精神崩潰了！！我們一次又一次試圖離開那個地方，花了將近一年時間試圖逃離，但總是回到海龜島的海岸。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
As we struggled with the fog, we lost our comrades one by one. In the end, Jornadan, the drunken old man you met, and myself were the only ones who were able to return home to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
在與濃霧搏鬥的過程中，我們失去了一個又一個同伴。最終，只有你見過的那個醉醺醺的老人約爾納丹和我，成功回到了艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
We were the only ones who did not give in to despair, and doggedly held onto our hopes. Still, it was by pure luck that we found a way back to Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
我們是唯一沒有向絕望屈服、頑強堅守希望的人。即便如此，能回到盧恩·米德加茲也純屬運氣。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Well, that's my story. You know, if you want to learn more about Turtle Island, why don't you speak to the scholar on the eastern port of Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
好了，這就是我的故事。你知道嗎，如果你想了解更多關於海龜島的事，不妨去艾爾貝塔東港找那位學者談談？

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Heh heh...
I'm sure he can tell give you details that even I wouldn't be able to provide...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
嘿嘿...
我相信他能給你講出連我都無法提供的細節...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
After my story of Turtle Island, you're still not afraid of going? I'm impressed! Alright then...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
聽了我的海龜島故事，你竟然還一點都不害怕？真讓我佩服！好吧...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
If you wish for me to guide you there, I will charge you 10,000 zeny. I'm the only navigator that can guide you there and back safely.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
如果你想讓我帶你去那裡，我會收取10,000 Zeny。我是唯一能安全地帶你往返那裡的領航員。

scripts.text: Turtle island -> 10000 zeny
scripts.translation: 前往海龜島 -> 10000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Alright!!
You've made your choice! With my experience, we will arrive without fail! I appreciate your spirit!
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
好！！
你做出了選擇！憑藉我的經驗，我們一定能順利抵達！我很欣賞你的勇氣！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Choo Choo*^000000

[Gotanblue]
Hmmm...
Sorry, but you don't have enough zeny. I hope you understand that I can let my expertise and experience be undervalued...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
嗯...
抱歉，你的Zeny不夠。希望你能理解，我不能讓我的專業和經驗被低估...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Alright then...
Well, if the spirit of adventure should happen to grab you, I will be here waiting.
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
好吧...
如果冒險的衝動再次抓住你，我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Heh...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Come back whenever you feel you're ready to hear my story, will you?
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
等你準備好聽我的故事時，隨時回來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Ahhhh...!
Just look at that ocean! It covers the earth as far as the eye can see. Tell me that's not one of the most beautiful things you've ever seen...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
啊...
看看那片大海！一眼望不到邊，覆蓋了大地。告訴我，這難道不是你見過的最美麗的景色之一嗎...

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Do you want
to return
to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
你想回
艾爾貝塔嗎？

scripts.text: Go to Alberta
scripts.translation: 前往艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Stop talking
scripts.translation: 別說了

scripts.text:
[Gotanblue]
Heh heh...
I certainly hope you've found what you were looking for. Alright, I guess there's always a time for an adventurer to return home...
scripts.translation:
[戈坦布魯]
嘿嘿...
希望你找到了你想要的東西。好吧，我想冒險者總該有個回家的時間...

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Choo Choo *^000000

[Jornadan Niliria]
Every single place
has its own unique
smells, sights and sounds.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
每一個地方
都有它獨特的
氣味、景色和聲音。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Even the great, ever expanding sky that's shared by all the peoples of the earth looks strange when you're in a new and foreign land.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
即使是那片廣闊無垠、被地球上所有民族共享的天空，當你身處陌生的異國他鄉時，看起來也會變得有些奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Jornandan Niliria]
Heh heh...
Just like my
time on Turtle Island.
Hah Hah Hah~
scripts.translation:
[約爾南丹·尼利里亞]
嘿嘿...
就像我在
海龜島的那段時光。
哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text: About Turtle island
scripts.translation: 關於海龜島

scripts.text: You're Jornadan Niliria?!
scripts.translation: 你是約爾納丹·尼利里亞？！

scripts.text: Stop talking
scripts.translation: 別說了

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Turtle...
Island...
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
海龜...
島...

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
It's almost silly, but Turtle Island was named simply because it's shaped just like a turtle.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
說來有點可笑，海龜島之所以叫這個名字，僅僅是因為它的形狀就像一隻海龜。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Now, Turtle Island is surrounded by a dense fog. When we were first stuck in it, a lot of us believed it was the result of a curse, or some kind of magic.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
如今，海龜島被濃霧環繞。當我們最初被困在那裡時，很多人相信這是詛咒或某種魔法的結果。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
But in actuality, the fog is the result of a natural phenomenon. It's created by a waterfall inside a cave located on Turtle Island's coast.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
但實際上，這種霧是自然現象造成的。它是由海龜島海岸一處洞穴內的瀑布形成的。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Heh heh...
Once you attain understanding, the truth becomes so simple. I guess confusion and fear is the fog that clouds your judgment, your path on life.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
嘿嘿...
一旦你理解了，真相就變得如此簡單。我想，困惑和恐懼就是遮蔽你判斷、你人生道路的迷霧。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Believe it or not, I too used to fear the dangers of Turtle Island. But now that I understand most of its secrets, I look at my experiences at Turtle Island with fondness.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
信不信由你，我也曾害怕海龜島的危險。但現在我瞭解了它的大部分秘密，我反而對在海龜島的經歷充滿了懷念。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Still, there is one thing I haven't yet uncovered. The ^3355FFunknown jewel fragment^000000.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
不過，有一樣東西我至今還沒有發現。^3355FF未知的寶石碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jornandan Niliria]
So, until I find it, I'll keep researching and learn as much as I can until I do. Ha ha ha ha~!
scripts.translation:
[約爾南丹·尼利里亞]
所以，在找到它之前，我會繼續研究，儘可能多地瞭解它。哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Hmm...?
You've heard of me?
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
嗯...？
你聽說過我？

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Ah...
I suppose that you know about my treasure hunting days, and probably about Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
啊...
我想你應該知道我的尋寶經歷，大概也聽說過海龜島。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
Well, as you can see, I'm a little older now. These old bones aren't what they used to be.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
你看，我現在年紀大了些。這把老骨頭可不如從前了。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
But perhaps, someday, if my research bears fruit, I'll venture out once more and seek the one treasure I've never found...
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
不過也許有一天，如果我的研究有所收穫，我會再次出發，去尋找那件我從未找到的寶物...

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
When you want to discover the truth, never give in to despair. If you never give up your search, the answer will come to you.
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
當你想要發現真相時，永遠不要向絕望屈服。如果你永不放棄尋找，答案終會來到你面前。

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
...
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
...

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
...
......
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
...
......

scripts.text:
[Jornadan Niliria]
By the way, I'm pretty hungry. Why doesn't Alberta have any good restaurants?! I hear they have good dimsum in Kunlun...
scripts.translation:
[約爾納丹·尼利里亞]
順便說一句，我有點餓了。為什麼艾爾貝塔沒有像樣的餐廳？！我聽說崑崙有很好吃的小籠包...

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
- O / X / XOVX -
If you find this letter, please don't disregard what you have read.
scripts.translation:
[探險者的信]
- O / X / XOVX -
如果你發現了這封信，請不要忽視你所讀到的內容。

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
Although we have found Turtle Island, it seems our expedition will fail.
scripts.translation:
[探險者的信]
雖然我們找到了海龜島，但我們的探險似乎要失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
Only half of our crew is left, and we only have enough food for ten more days. Our condition is truly grave.
scripts.translation:
[探險者的信]
船員只剩下了一半，而且我們只夠吃十天的食物。我們的處境非常嚴峻。

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
This damn island must be cursed. There's nothing to eat and we're so close to starving!
scripts.translation:
[探險者的信]
該死的島肯定是被詛咒了。這裡沒有任何食物，我們快要餓死了！

scripts.text:
[Explorer's Letter]
If we don't get help or find Alberta soon...
We'll...
scripts.translation:
[探險者的信]
如果我們不能儘快得到援助或找到艾爾貝塔...
我們就會...

scripts.text:
[Voyage log]
03:20 am
There's no light from the stars tonight, and we can't even see a hundred meters ahead of us. The men seem to feel something bad in the air.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
凌晨03:20
今晚看不見星光，前方連一百米都看不清。船員們似乎都感覺到空氣中瀰漫著不祥的氣息。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
The faces of my comrades betrayed their fears. They couldn't manage to sleep last night. I hope we will see sunrise soon...
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
同志們的臉上寫滿了恐懼。他們昨晚都失眠了。希望我們很快能看到日出...

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
04:10 
5 minutes ago, our comrade, Cooker, was killed when the mast suddenly cracked and fell on his head.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
04:10
五分鐘前，我們的同志廚師被突然斷裂並砸落的桅杆擊中頭部，不幸身亡。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
The estimated time of death is 04:07. The mast broke due to the shock of the ship hitting a reef. The left side of the deck also suffered from serious damage.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
預計死亡時間為04:07。桅杆是因為船撞擊暗礁的衝擊而斷裂的。甲板左側也受到了嚴重損壞。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
04:45
While two of our workers were fixing the bottom of the deck, they were attacked by monsters that had snuck through cracks in the deck.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
04:45
兩名工人正在修補甲板底部時，被從甲板縫隙中鑽進來的魔物襲擊了。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
These two were lost in the attack. The estimated time of death was 04:32. Fortunately, we are able to stay afloat, but we must hurry and find land.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
這兩人在襲擊中喪生。預計死亡時間為04:32。幸運的是，船還能漂浮，但我們必須加快速度尋找陸地。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
From the damage to the deck, we've lost 30% of our supplies. At this rate, we'll run out of food soon.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
由於甲板受損，我們損失了30%的補給品。照這個速度下去，我們的食物很快就會耗盡。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
05:23
There seem to be more and more reefs to steer around, and they are growing larger as we travel. I wonder if we'll find land soon...
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
05:23
需要繞行的暗礁似乎越來越多，而且隨著航行的推進，它們也越來越大。不知道我們能不能很快找到陸地...

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Written by
Captain Jornadan Niliria
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
記錄者
船長 約爾納丹·尼利里亞

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe paper is torn and seaweed and mold are stuck to the paper. It seems this log is in very poor condition...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF紙張已經破損，上面粘著海草和黴菌。看來這份日誌的狀況非常糟糕...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThere is a banana leaf between some of the pages. Here is what is written.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在幾頁紙之間夾著一片香蕉葉。上面寫著以下內容。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
O / X date
Just after we arrived on Turtle Island, we frantically searched all over for food.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
O / X 日
剛到達海龜島後，我們瘋狂地到處尋找食物。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
It was so bad, that you could see the bones through our skin.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
情況非常糟糕，我們瘦得皮包骨頭。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
X / X date
We found some kind of fruit to eat! It's covered in some sort of yellow skin and looks like a banana!
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
X / X 日
我們找到了一種可以吃的果實！它外面包著黃色的皮，看起來像香蕉！

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
XO / X date
Well, it wasn't exactly like the bananas we have in Rune-Midgarts, but it was very similar.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
XO / X 日
嗯，它和盧恩·米德加茲的香蕉不太一樣，但非常相似。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
O / O date
In the middle of the night, one of the men reported that he felt sick after eating the food.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
O / O 日
半夜裡，一名船員報告說，吃了那些食物後感到噁心。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
OO / O date
Another crew member, Berot Berot, was also found to have severe indigestion.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
OO / O 日
另一名船員貝羅特·貝羅特也被發現患有嚴重的消化不良。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
It's now becoming very clear that the food we have been eating contains some kind of poison.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
現在越來越明顯了，我們一直在吃的食物裡含有某種毒素。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
XO / O date
The third person to experience indigestion passed away today. We are all very worried.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
XO / O 日
第三名出現消化不良症狀的人今天去世了。我們都非常擔心。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Our suspicions were confirmed when we found that the animals on Turtle Island wouldn't eat the bananas we found.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
當我們發現海龜島上的動物不吃我們找到的香蕉時，我們的懷疑得到了證實。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
OX / O date
We decided to seal away this poisonous fruit, but learned that it didn't rot, not even after we removed the skin.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
OX / O 日
我們決定封存這種有毒的水果，但發現它不會腐爛，即使剝去果皮也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
We have no idea why it's harmful to eat, or why it never perishes, but it be of some medical or scientific interest.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
我們不知道它為什麼有害，也不知道它為什麼不會腐爛，但它可能對醫學或科學研究有價值。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
In the meantime, we've decided to bury this fruit until we can get back to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
在此期間，我們決定將這種水果埋起來，直到我們回到艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: ^3355FFIn the Voyage log is a thin key marked with a skull. You've taken this Skull key, as it may be of some use later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF航海日誌中有一把刻有骷髏圖案的細鑰匙。你拿走了這把骷髏鑰匙，因為它以後可能會有用。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou notice a page with a stamp shaped like a bird's foot. The black ink smells sort of like fruit.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你注意到一頁紙上有一個鳥爪形狀的印章。黑色的墨水聞起來有點像水果的味道。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
X / OO date
We've found evidence that other people were here, and that we are not the first to find Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
X / OO 日

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
There was at least one person who made it here before us. Hopefully, his records are on the island somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
至少有一人先於我們到達這裡。希望他的記錄在島上的某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Starting tomorrow, we will begin searching for these hidden records.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
從明天開始，我們將開始尋找這些隱藏的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
O / OO date
We are having difficulty trying to find any records. Is it possible that the first people here wrote nothing of their journey?
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
O / OO 日
我們很難找到任何記錄。難道第一批來到這裡的人沒有寫下他們的旅程嗎？

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
XO / OO date
We finally found the records we have been searching for.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
XO / OO 日
我們終於找到了我們一直在尋找的記錄。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
His notes were so hard to find because only one man, rather than a whole team, came to Turtle Island before us!
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
他的筆記之所以很難找到，是因為先於我們來到海龜島的只有一個人，而不是整個團隊！

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
This man was a swordsman simply known as 'One.' His records tell much about what can be found on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
這名男子是一名劍士，人們只稱他為“一”。他的記錄詳細描述了海龜島上能找到的東西。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
His records were written on animals skin, but they were durable and still easy to read after all this time.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
他的記錄寫在動物皮上，但非常耐用，經過這麼長時間後仍然清晰易讀。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
According to his notes, Turtle Island consists of 4 levels. Although there are no people here, but there are many traps and devices which operate through a mysterious force.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
根據他的筆記，海龜島由4層組成。雖然這裡沒有人，但有許多通過神秘力量運作的陷阱和裝置。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
Still, it is certain that something has some control over Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
不過，可以確定的是，某物在控制著海龜島。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
To keep this record safe, our crew has decided to hide this valuable record on the second level of Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
為了安全儲存這份記錄，我們的船員決定將這份珍貴的記錄藏在海龜島的第二層。

海龜島上最大的寶藏，前所未見，被封印在某個秘密的地方...

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
We have spent many days searching for it, but found not one trace.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]
我們花了很多天尋找它，但沒有找到一絲線索。

scripts.text:
[Voyage Log]
In the meantime, we've collected many precious treasures. We've decided to take only some of it back home, and to leave the rest here.

[航海日誌]
在此期間，我們收集了許多珍貴的寶物。我們決定只帶一部分回家，剩下的留在這裡。

We have hidden the treasure we have left behind to keep it from getting stolen.
scripts.translation:
[航海日誌]

scripts.translation: ^3355FF抽屜裡有一個神秘紫箱。它現在歸你了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside the drawer,
is a Dead Branch.
It is now yours to keep.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF抽屜裡有一根枯樹枝。它現在歸你了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt is a turtle statue
made of ordinary turtle
stone. On top of it is
the word 'Security.'^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是一座由普通龜石製成的雕像。頂部寫著“安全”二字。^000000

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Where did all my men go?!
This is horrible~!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
我的手下都去哪了？！
太糟糕了~！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Oh...
*Whew!*
Finally, another person.
Tell me who you are!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
哦...
*呼！*
終於又來了一個人。
告訴我你是誰！

scripts.text: Who are you to ask?
scripts.translation: 你憑什麼問我？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: First, tell me who you are.
scripts.translation: 先告訴我你是誰。

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
How dare you speak to me in that tone! Don't you know who I am?! I'm Takuyaka, leader of the Security Knights of Alberta! Kobolds and Porings quiver in fear when they hear my name...
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
你竟敢用這種語氣跟我說話！你難道不知道我是誰嗎？！我是拓也香，艾爾貝塔安全騎士團的首領！刺錘犬妖和波利聽到我的名字都會嚇得發抖...

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
So tell me the truth! You came here for treasure, didn't you?! You want it all for yourself! You bastard! Now get off this island! Go, shoo!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
所以老實交代！你是來尋寶的，對吧？！你想獨吞所有寶物！你這個混蛋！現在立刻離開這座島！走，快走！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
{0}?
Well, your name sounds better than mine. And you have more hair on your head as well. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
{0}？
嗯，你的名字聽起來比我的好聽。而且你頭上的頭髮也比我多。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Do you have anything to give me? You know, some food or zeny? It's not like I really need it, it's just... Oh bother. Never mind. Perhaps we'll meet later.
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
你有什麼東西可以給我嗎？比如食物或者Zeny？其實我也不是真的需要，只是...哎呀，算了。也許我們以後還會見面。

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
I've heard that many treasures can be found on Turtle Island. If I can take enough home, I'll be rich! Well, we're supposed to rescue lost adventurers too, but whatever. As leader, I can do whatever I want!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
我聽說海龜島上有很多寶物。如果我帶夠多的回去，我就能發財了！雖然我們也應該去救援迷路的冒險者，但無所謂。作為首領，我想做什麼就做什麼！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
However, we're totally lost. Meaning we can't find any treasure or even rescue any people. Grrr...! Where are my useless soldiers! I've probably spoiled them with too much food!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
不過，我們完全迷路了。也就是說，我們找不到任何寶物，甚至無法救援任何人。可惡...！我那群沒用計程車兵都在哪！我大概是給他們吃了太多好吃的，把他們慣壞了！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
If you see any of them, tell them they must assemble here! Alright?!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
如果你看到他們，告訴他們必須在這裡集合！聽到了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Me? I'm Takuyaka. A tall, dark, handsome, and dashing leader, as well as a fearsome knight! I have come to save the foolish people of Alberta that have come seeking treasure on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
我？我是拓也香。一個高大、英俊、瀟灑的首領，也是一位令人畏懼的騎士！我來這裡是為了拯救那些來到海龜島尋寶的艾爾貝塔愚民。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
Really, now?
scripts.translation:
[穆達薩姆]
真的假的？

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Quiet!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
安靜！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Anyway, we came here with the purest of intents. But right when we arrived, we were attacked by monsters! Because of the confusion from all the fighting, my soldiers were scattered.
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
總之，我們是懷著最純真的意圖來到這裡的。但剛一到，就被魔物襲擊了！因為戰鬥造成的混亂，我計程車兵們四散奔逃。

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Mudasamu!
Why is this
happening to me!!!!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
穆達薩姆！
為什麼這種事
會發生在
我身上！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
Huh...!
Why should you
be surprised,
you chubby dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[穆達薩姆]
哈...！
你驚訝什麼，
你這胖矮人？

scripts.text:
[Scared Voice]
Wh-wh-whaat?!
scripts.translation:
[害怕的聲音]
什...什...什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Terrified Voice]
What's that noise?!
M-M-Mudasamu!
Protect me!
scripts.translation:
[驚恐的聲音]
那是什麼聲音？！
穆...穆達薩姆！
保護我！

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
No.
And shut up.
scripts.translation:
[穆達薩姆]
不。
閉嘴。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
My name is Mudasamu...
Second in command of the
Alberta Security Knights.
scripts.translation:
[穆達薩姆]
我是穆達薩姆...
艾爾貝塔保安騎士團的
副指揮官。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
We've come here to rescue treasure hunters that might be in trouble. However, our leader is this porky specimen right next to me. So I guess I foresaw that this mission would fail.
scripts.translation:
[穆達薩姆]
我們來到這裡是為了救援可能有麻煩的尋寶者。然而，我們的首領就是旁邊這個肥碩的傢伙。所以我早就料到這次任務會失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
Basically, our leader was so distracted by the idea of finding treasure himself that we've lost our men. It's bad enough that he's a fat slob, but he's a greedy slob too!
scripts.translation:
[穆達薩姆]
基本上，我們的首領因為想著自己尋寶而分心，導致我們失去了士兵。他不僅是個胖子，還是個貪婪的傢伙！

scripts.text:
[Takuyaka]
Hey, Mudasamu!
Are you talking
about me?!
scripts.translation:
[拓也香]
嘿，穆達薩姆！
你在說
我嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
No, fat one,
we're not
talking about you.
scripts.translation:
[穆達薩姆]
不，胖子，
我們說的
不是你。

scripts.text:
[Mudasamu]
*Sigh...*
I better be paid
overtime for
putting up with this.
scripts.translation:
[穆達薩姆]
*嘆氣...*
忍受這些，
我最好能拿到
加班費。

scripts.text:
[?]
Where are they?
Oh hey! You're an adventurer, aren't you? Do you know where my comrades are?
scripts.translation:
[?]
他們在哪？
哦，嘿！你是冒險者，對吧？你知道我的同志們在哪嗎？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不知道。

scripts.text: Why did you come here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼來這裡？

scripts.text: How did you get here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎麼來到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[Passats]
My name is Passats, a proud Security Knight of Alberta. We've obtained some information that some people came here to seek treasure.
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
我是帕薩茨，艾爾貝塔引以為傲的保安騎士。我們得到了一些情報，說有人來這裡尋寶。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Our task here is to save people, but when we arrived on Turtle Island, we were attacked by a mob of monsters! So we all got scattered.
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
我們在這裡的任務是救人，但當我們到達海龜島時，被一群魔物襲擊了！所以我們四散奔逃。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Now I'm all alone. If you find anyone else in my unit, would you let them know?
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
現在只有我一個人了。如果你找到我小隊的其他人，能讓他們知道我的位置嗎？

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Ah well...
Well, if you happen to find anyone else in my unit, would you let them know where I am?
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
唉...
如果你碰巧找到我小隊的其他人，能讓他們知道我在哪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Passat]
Oh, and if you find our leader, kick his butt, will you? It's so fat, there's no way you can miss.
scripts.translation:
[帕薩特]
哦，對了，如果你找到我們的首領，幫我揍他一頓，好嗎？他那麼胖，你肯定找得到的。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Oh...
And, um...
Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
哦...
那個，嗯...
振作起來！

scripts.text:
[Passats]
There are a lot of stories about the amazing wealth that can be found on this island. However, everyone assumed that it was impossible to find Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
關於這座島上藏有驚人財富的故事有很多。然而，大家都認為找到海龜島是不可能的。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
But then, the problem began when some navigator actually knew the way to Turtle Island. I think he'll take just about anybody for 10,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
但後來，問題出現了，因為有一位領航員竟然知道去海龜島的路。我想他大概只要10,000 Zeny就會帶任何人去吧！

scripts.text:
[Passats]
So anyway, some of the people of Alberta have been foolishly coming here, hoping to find treasure. But of course, they can't fight monsters.
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
總之，艾爾貝塔的一些人愚蠢地來到這裡，希望能找到寶藏。但當然，他們打不過魔物。

scripts.text:
[Passats]
So now we're here in order to seek out towners in trouble, and send them safely back home. Of course, now it seems that we also need rescuing...
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
所以我們現在在這裡，是為了尋找陷入困境的鎮民，並安全地送他們回家。當然，現在看來，我們也需要被救援了...

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Passats]
No clue.
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
完全不知道。

scripts.text: How can that be?!
scripts.translation: 怎麼會這樣？！

scripts.text:
[Passats]
Oh, don't be angry. I just drank too much vodka! Before we arrived I was still unconscious and when I finally sobered up, I was here. I'm so embarrassed~
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
哦，別生氣。我只是喝了太多伏特加！在我們到達之前我還處於昏迷狀態，等我終於清醒過來時，我就在這裡了。我真丟人~

scripts.text:
[Passats]
I...
I'm a victim too~
scripts.translation:
[帕薩茨]
我...
我也是受害者~

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
Oh? Are you a civilian? Nice to meet you. I'm a mighty Security Knight of Alberta, Jayprocat.
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
哦？你是平民嗎？很高興見到你。我是艾爾貝塔強大的保安騎士，傑普羅卡特。

scripts.text: What is that, exactly?
scripts.translation: 那到底是什麼？

scripts.text: I'm not impressed.
scripts.translation: 我不太感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
Well...
We're supposed to protect the people of Alberta. That's our job as proud Security Knights.
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
嗯...
我們本應該保護艾爾貝塔的人民。這是我們作為自豪的保安騎士的職責。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
So when a bunch of them caught treasure fever and started coming here, we came to rescue them. Anyway, that was the plan.
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
所以當一群人染上尋寶熱並開始來這裡時，我們來救援他們了。總之，計劃是這樣的。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
It turns out that by some joke by fate, our leader is this pudgy guy who attracted a mob on monsters to us by noisily digging up treasure, instead of doing what we were supposed to do.
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
結果由於命運的捉弄，我們的首領是個胖乎乎的傢伙，他沒有做我們應該做的事，而是大聲地挖掘寶藏，結果引來了一群魔物攻擊我們。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
*Sigh...*
Why wasn't Mudasamu in charge? With him as leader, I would've been home for dinner...
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
*嘆氣...*
為什麼不是穆達薩姆負責？如果他是首領，我早就回家吃晚飯了...

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
Well...
It's true that we pretty much messed up our current mission to save anyone here seeking for treasure, since we need rescuing now as well.
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
嗯...
確實，我們基本上搞砸了當前拯救這裡尋寶者的任務，因為現在我們也需要被救援了。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
*Sniff*
Why did we have to be attacked by so many monsters on my first mission? I'm... I'm just a new recruit...
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
*吸鼻子*
為什麼在我的第一次任務中就要被這麼多魔物攻擊？我...我只是一個新兵...

scripts.text: Why did you run away?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼逃跑？

scripts.text: I don't care.
scripts.translation: 我不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
No, I didn't just run away! The monsters were too stong and there were so many of them! Plus, it's our damn leader's fault.
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
不，我不是單純地逃跑！那些魔物太強了，而且數量太多了！再說了，這都是我們那個該死的首領的錯。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
The monsters are all highly evolved turtles. And this island even looks like a turtle! But I guess you knew that already.
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
那些魔物全是進化後的高階烏龜。而且這座島看起來也像只烏龜！不過我想你早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
I had no idea that this island's monsters were so much stronger than the ones that live near Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
我完全沒想到這座島上的魔物比艾爾貝塔附近的要強這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
Their shells are so tough, and we can't seem to find any sort of weak point! I have no idea how to fight these turtles!
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
它們的殼太硬了，我們似乎找不到任何弱點！我根本不知道該怎麼對付這些烏龜！

scripts.text:
[Jayprocat]
You're so mean...
I mean, I'm really new at this!
scripts.translation:
[傑普羅卡特]
你太壞了...
我是說，我真的是新手啊！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Am I the only one left? Where are all my comrades?! I... I'm about to go crazy!
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
難道只剩下我一個人了嗎？我的同志們都在哪裡？！我...我快要瘋了！

scripts.text: Maybe they ran away?
scripts.translation: 也許他們逃跑了？

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Squall]
No, we would never run away from the face of danger.
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
不，我們絕不會在危險面前逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Well, we sort of did, but that was because it was a direct order from our leader! If a knight is loyal and proud, he will accept his leader's orders without question!
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
好吧，我們確實跑了，但那是因為那是首領的直接命令！如果一名騎士忠誠且自豪，他會毫不猶豫地接受首領的命令！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Even if that leader is a little greedy, with hair that might be thinning...
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
即使那個首領有點貪婪，頭髮可能有點稀疏...

scripts.text:
[Squall]
^FF0000And has the body
of a pregnant whale^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
^FF0000而且身材像懷孕的鯨魚一樣^000000。

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Oh wait!
I shouldn't
have said that!
What I meant
to say was...
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
哎呀！
我不該說那個的！
我想說的是...

scripts.text:
[Squall]
^CC0000And has the
body of a whale
pregnant with twins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
^CC0000而且身材像懷了雙胞胎的鯨魚^000000。

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Grrrr...!
I'm so angry!
Why can't Mudasamu
be our leader?!
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
嗚...
我氣死了！
為什麼穆達薩姆不能當我們的首領？！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
We had good plans for this mission, made by our second in command, Mudasamu. However, they were executely poorly by the first in command.
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
我們為這次任務制定了周密的計劃，是由副指揮官穆達薩姆制定的。然而，指揮官卻執行得一塌糊塗。

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Whenever Takuyaka leads a mission, he always manages to mess it up! Why do the leaders in Alberta like him anyway?!
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
每次拓也香領導任務，總是搞得一團糟！艾爾貝塔的高層為什麼那麼喜歡他？！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
*Sniff*
I sweat and I bleed for the Alberta Security Knights, and still I'm tortured by the fact that Sir Porky commands us. I hate it!
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
*吸鼻子*
我為艾爾貝塔安全騎士流汗流血，卻還要忍受豬頭爵士指揮我們。我討厭這樣！

scripts.text:
[Squall]
Our weapon and armor budget is always gone after Takuyaka visits a buffet... Why do we have to be so miserable?!
scripts.translation:
[斯考爾]
我們的武器和防具預算總是在拓也香去自助餐廳後花光...為什麼我們要這麼悲慘？！

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Hm? I'm surprised that someone around here is still alive.
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
嗯？我很驚訝這裡居然還有人活著。

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
I'm beginning to think all my comrades have been killed by the monsters here...
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
我開始覺得，我的同志們可能都已經被這裡的魔物殺害了...

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Having a
tough time?
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
遇到麻煩了？

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Even though you're pretty strong, sooner or later you might need a reprieve. I can send you back to Alberta right now if you want.
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
雖然你很強大，但遲早也會需要休息一下。如果你願意，我現在就可以把你送回艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: Yes, Help me.
scripts.translation: 是的，幫幫我。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Okay then, let me activate this teleport thingee donated to us by Kafra Corporation...
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
好的，讓我啟動這個由卡普拉總公司捐贈給我們的傳送裝置...

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Ah, that's the spirit! You should be careful though. And if you see any other of my comrades, let them know I'm here, would you?
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
啊，這才是好樣的！不過你要小心。如果你遇到我的其他同志，請告訴他們我還在這裡，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Well, good luck!
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
那麼，祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
You look lost! If you stick around here, well, the monsters will probably get the best of you sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
你看起來迷路了！如果你留在這裡，遲早會被魔物打敗的。

scripts.text:
[Nyusurea]
Anyway...
Good luck!
You'll need it!
scripts.translation:
[尼烏蘇蕾亞]
總之...
祝你好運！
你會用得上的！

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Huh...
You look calm and collected. If all our soldiers were as strong as you, we probably would not have been scattered.
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
嗯...
你看起來很冷靜沉著。如果我們計程車兵都像你一樣強大，我們大概就不會落得如此分散的境地了。

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
I have dreams of becoming a great knight, but since our 'leader' is all plump and no brains, we're stuck in this predicament.
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
我夢想著成為一名偉大的騎士，但既然我們的“首領”是個只有肥肉沒有腦子的傢伙，我們就只能被困在這種困境中了。

scripts.text:
[Nysurea]
Anyway, be careful in this third level of Turtle Island. A lot of our men were annihilated when they went to explore the East and North sides, so be careful!
scripts.translation:
[尼蘇蕾亞]
總之，在海龜島第三層要小心。我們有很多人在探索東側和北側時被殲滅了，所以務必小心！

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But... this world is...
What a big world... Not just humans...
Other lifeforms just like us...
Where could they be?...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
但是...這個世界是...
多麼廣闊的世界...不僅僅是人類...
還有像我們一樣的其他生命形式...
它們會在哪裡呢？...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Their lives.. and...
Their kingdom... and land...
Where could they be...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...它們的生活...以及...
它們的王國...和土地...
它們會在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
If they exist, that'd be great...
No... they must exist...
I wish one day... one day I can go there...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
如果它們存在的話，那該多好啊...
不...它們一定存在...
我希望有一天...有一天我能去那裡...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
If it's too painful...
It's better if I don't...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
如果太痛苦的話...
最好還是不要...

scripts.text: -Silent pause-
scripts.translation: -沉默的停頓-

scripts.text:
-{0} starts to speak-
-And tells him of the journeys-
-Adventures, joy, sorrow, and loss-
-One by one to the boy-
scripts.translation:
-{0}開始說話-
-向他講述旅途-
-冒險、喜悅、悲傷和失去-
-一件一件地告訴男孩-

scripts.text:
-Fighting monsters, and winning-
-Coming across many people, and-
-leaving them, and tells of many other things-
-As much as possible, to the boy.-
scripts.translation:
-與魔物戰鬥並獲勝-
-遇到許多人，然後-
-離開他們，並講述許多其他事情-
-儘可能多地告訴男孩。-

scripts.text:
-Much has happened, and-
-There were many dangers, but in the end-
-Happy things outweighs the bad,-
-What I have received is more than what I have lost.-
-I try hard to convey this message to Iromo.-
scripts.translation:
-發生了很多事情，-
-經歷了許多危險，但最終-
-快樂的事情多於悲傷，-
-我得到的比我失去的更多。-
-我努力向伊羅莫傳達這個資訊。-

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...

[Iromo]
...So in the end...
You just want me... to go outside...
Am I right...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...所以到頭來...
你只是想讓我...出去...
對吧...

scripts.text: It's true, you'll get more than you pay.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，你會得到比付出更多的。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...

[Iromo]
...But now... I am not going outside.
I am still afraid...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...但現在...我不出去。
我還是害怕...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Even if I don't go out right now,
I will still... make an effort to do so.
One day, I will surely become...
..An adventurer... and do many, many things.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
即使我現在不出去，
我也會...努力嘗試的。
總有一天，我一定會成為...
...一名冒險者...去做很多很多事情。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
The world is big, there are many things...
I have not seen yet. Yes... I want to...
...see them all.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
世界很大，有很多事情...
我還沒有見過。是的...我想...
...去看看它們。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
To go on an adventure with my friends,
I would still rather stay here.
I would still rather stay here quietly and safely.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
雖然想和朋友們去冒險，
但我還是寧願留在這裡。
我還是寧願安靜、安全地留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Alright...go away. I know...
I know what you want to say...what an annoyance...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
好了...走吧。我知道...
我知道你想說什麼...真煩人...

scripts.text:
-You don't give up, and continue to-
-tell of the stories-
-shared with friends.-
-You tell of the truth.-
scripts.translation:
-你不放棄，繼續-
-講述那些-
-與朋友分享的故事。-
-你講述的是真相。-

scripts.text:
-Someone met long ago,-
-Suddenly leaves,-
-and finally reunited, but-
-because of the cruel fate-
-he dies in this tragedy.-
-In the end, it's all a tragedy...-
scripts.translation:
-很久以前認識的人，-
-突然離開，-
-最終重逢，但-
-因為殘酷的命運-
-他死在了這場悲劇中。-
-到頭來，這都是一場悲劇...-

scripts.text:
-But you emphasize -
-Even though the ending is tragic,-
-A beautiful friendship-
-Will not disappear because of that.-
scripts.translation:
-但你強調-
-雖然結局是悲劇，-
-但美好的友誼-
-不會因為這就消失。-

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...

[Iromo]
...Thank you for telling me...
They are great friends...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...謝謝你告訴我...
他們是好朋友...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...And? ...What do you...
Want to say to me this time...
You've told me many stories...
...How about one of your own?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...然後呢？...你這次...
想對我說什麼...
你已經給我講了很多故事...
...不如講講你自己的？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...And? ...What do you...
Want to say to me this time...
You've told me many stories...
...How about one of your own?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...然後呢？...你這次...
想對我說什麼...
你已經給我講了很多故事...
...不如講講你自己的？

scripts.text: Friendship cannot be forgotten.
scripts.translation: 友誼不能被遺忘。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
To have that kind of friends and that kind of friendship...
scripts.translation: 擁有那樣的朋友和那樣的友誼...

scripts.text: You need to get out of your house and see the world.
scripts.translation: 你需要走出家門，去看看這個世界。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Though you changed a story... but...
You're still talking about this...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
雖然你換了個故事...但是...
你還是在說這個...

scripts.text: To be honest, the other kids miss you.
scripts.translation: 說實話，其他孩子都很想念你。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Him? ...Miss me? That's...
Something from a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...他？...想念我？那是...
很久以前的事了...

scripts.text: There are many things you don't know yet.
scripts.translation: 還有很多事情你並不知道。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
Don't you think it's a waste to stay home?
scripts.translation: 你覺得一直待在家裡不是太浪費了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
In order to find safety, you would give up fun adventures?
scripts.translation: 為了尋求安全，你願意放棄有趣的冒險嗎？

scripts.text: That's too bad. Change is a very fun thing.
scripts.translation: 真遺憾。變化是一件非常有趣的事。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Change...
Is fun...?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...變化...
很有趣...？

scripts.text: Outside this city and this kingdom, there is a bigger world.
scripts.translation: 在這座城市和這個王國之外，還有一個更大的世界。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
Since it's so big, there are many fun things.
scripts.translation: 正因為很大，所以有很多有趣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Really...? Other than Alberta, and Rune-Midgarts...?
There are other places...?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
真的...？除了艾爾貝塔和盧恩·米德加茲...？
還有其他地方...？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But... there will also be many troubles...
Isn't that true... I can't relax...
I... don't like those...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
但是...也會有很多麻煩...
是這樣嗎...我無法放鬆...
我...不喜歡那些...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
To go on an adventure with my friends,
I would still rather stay here.
I would still rather stay here quietly and safely.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
雖然想和朋友們去冒險，
但我還是寧願留在這裡。
我還是寧願安靜、安全地留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Alright... go away. I know...
I know what you want to say... what an annoyance...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
好了...走吧。我知道...
我知道你想說什麼...真煩人...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...You really are annoying...
What exactly do you want from me...?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...你真的很煩...
你到底想從我這裡得到什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
A long time ago... I had a friend just like you.
I met him when I went out to play...
But...
He must've forgotten all about me...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
很久以前...我有個和你一樣的朋友。
我出去玩的時候遇見了他...
但是...
他一定已經把我忘得一乾二淨了...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Nevermind... it's not unexpected...
To go on an adventure with my friends,
I would still rather stay here.
I would still rather stay here quietly and safely.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
算了...這也不奇怪...
和朋友們去冒險，
我還是更願意留在這裡。
我還是更願意在這裡安靜、安全地待著。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...What... Right now, I...
I don't want to... hear anything...
Go away...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...什麼...現在，我...
我不想...聽任何話...
走吧...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...What is it... this time...?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...這次又是什麼...？

scripts.text: A story about a pair of siblings.
scripts.translation: 關於一對兄妹的故事。

scripts.text:
-Tell him about Kazien and Lyozien.-
-Because of ill fate,-
-They were born to do illegal tasks-
-But the innocent Lyozien-
-Trusted his brother...-
scripts.translation:
-告訴他卡濟恩和廖齊恩的故事。-
-因為命運多舛，-
-他們生來就要從事非法的任務，-
-但天真的廖齊恩-
-卻信任著他的哥哥...-

scripts.text:
-And even though Kazien has become-
-a criminal, but as an older brother-
-He hopes to take good care of his younger brother.-
scripts.translation:
-儘管卡濟恩已經-
-成為了罪犯，但作為哥哥，-
-他希望好好照顧自己的弟弟。-

scripts.text:
-This is a story from far away,-
-But because you have seen it with your own eyes,-
-You can clearly express-
-Your feelings.-
scripts.translation:
-這是一個來自遠方的故事，-
-但因為你親眼所見，-
-你可以清晰地表達-
-你的感受。-

scripts.text:
-This story must be able to-
-Stir up the interest of-
-Iromo, who has always wanted a brother.-
scripts.translation:
-這個故事一定能-
-激起-
-一直渴望有個哥哥的伊羅莫-
-的興趣。-

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
I see...They were great siblings...
Tragic...but also beautiful.
If only...I can be the protagonist...
..in such a story...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
原來如此...他們是偉大的兄妹...
很悲慘...但也很美好。
要是...我能成為...
...這樣故事的主角就好了...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...But...I'm an only child...
...So there's nothing I can do...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...但是...我是獨生子...
...所以我什麼都做不了...

scripts.text: You don't need to be related by blood to be brothers.
scripts.translation: 不需要血緣關係也能成為兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...
You can find make of these brothers outside.
scripts.translation: 在外面可以找到這樣的兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Outside?...
But if you stay at home, nothing will change.
scripts.translation: 但如果你一直待在家裡，什麼都不會改變。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...

[Iromo]
...What... So it's all my fault...
What you want to say...
...is always the same...
Get out... I'm not in the mood...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...什麼...所以都是我的錯...
你想說的...
...總是那一套...
出去...我沒心情...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...I'm not in a good mood, get out...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...我現在心情不好，出去...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
You never give up, don't you?
What are you trying to say?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
你還真是不死心啊。
你到底想說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
It is frustrating. But...
Why do you care about me so much?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
真讓人頭疼。但是...
你為什麼這麼關心我？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Really, its not that bad...
I wish I could have a sister like you.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
真的，沒那麼嚴重...
我真希望能有個像你這樣的妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Really, its not that bad...
I wish I could have a brother like you.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
真的，沒那麼嚴重...
我真希望能有個像你這樣的哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Do you have any stories about siblings?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
你有什麼關於兄弟姐妹的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
What? Anything to say?
Seriously!
Just leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
什麼？有話就說？
認真的嗎！
別管我了。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Thank you for caring...
But that is ok...No thanks...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
謝謝你的關心...
但沒關係...不用謝...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Oh, you made the furious cat
go away from the village?
...Oh, you did..Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
哦，你把那隻發怒的貓
趕出村莊了？
...哦，你做了...謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But, I am still scared of
being outside.
I would rather stay at home.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
但是，我還是害怕
去外面。
我寧願待在家裡。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Thank you for being helpful.
But, no thanks.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
謝謝你的幫忙。
但是，不用謝。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
If I go out, I will see the scary cat.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
如果我出去，就會看到那隻可怕的貓。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
He will bite me..and
scratch me again.
I should stay at home.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
它會咬我...
還會抓傷我。
我應該待在家裡。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Huh? This smell...
This is the one I like the most.
Ha Ha!
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...咦？這個味道...
這是我最喜歡的味道。
哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But..my mom is beside me.
(Wink, Wink)
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
但是...媽媽就在我身邊。
(眨眼，眨眼)

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...Thanks! I need to hide this.
Anyway, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...謝謝！我得把這個藏起來。
總之，謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
It smells so good.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
聞起來好香。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Huh?? If I go out,
then can I get these things?
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
咦？？如果我出去，
就能得到這些東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But... I'm scared...
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
但是...我很害怕...

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
I am scared. If I go out...
No, I don't want to get hurt again.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
我很害怕。如果我出去...
不，我不想再受傷了。

scripts.text: Again?
scripts.translation: 再次

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
...there is a weird cat that can walk on two feet.
I like cats so I approached him.
Then suddenly he scratched and bit me.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...有一隻奇怪的貓，會用兩條腿走路。
我很喜歡貓，所以靠近了它。
然後它突然抓傷了我，還咬了我。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
I don't want to see the cat again.
If I go out, I will see him. It is scary.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
我不想再看到那隻貓了。
如果我出去，就會看到它。好可怕。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
... I don't like being outside of the village.
Being inside of the house is the best.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
...我不喜歡待在村莊外面。
待在家裡是最好的。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
Mother told me that
I should go out and play
with friends. But I don't
want to go out with them.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
媽媽告訴我，
我應該出去和朋友玩。
但是我不想和他們出去。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
It is little bit inconvenient that
I can't get delicious food
that grows outside of the village.
I can stand it.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
有點不方便的是，
我拿不到村莊外面長的美味食物。
但我能忍受。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
But, I can have other food
instead of the outside food.
That way I don't have to go out.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
但是，我可以吃其他食物，
代替外面的食物。
這樣我就不需要出去了。

scripts.text:
[Iromo]
I like my house and my room.
I don't want to go out.
scripts.translation:
[伊羅莫]
我喜歡我的房子和我的房間。
我不想出去。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Thank you for helping my son.
But I think we can't do anything
about him anymore.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
謝謝你幫助我的兒子。
但我覺得我們對他無能為力了。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Iromo was really active and
curious about the world.
He wanted to see all the
sights of the world.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
伊羅莫以前很活潑，
對世界充滿好奇。
他想看遍世界的美景。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
But look at him now.
He doesn't go out anymore.
He is just stuck inside of his room.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
但看看他現在。
他再也不出去了。
他只是被困在他的房間裡。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
He became a timid person.
If he has an argument with me,
he doesn't talk to me for a week.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
他變得很膽小。
如果和我吵架，
他會一週不跟我說話。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
You might have
a hard time getting
Iromo to talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
你可能很難
讓伊羅莫跟你說話。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Oh, I remember
what happened last time...
One day, Iromo came home
with tears in his eyes
And he seemed hurt.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
啊，我想起來了...
上次發生的事。
有一天，伊羅莫哭著回了家，
看起來受了傷。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
It was not a big injury.
I was worried about him so much.
But, he never tells me what happened that day.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
傷得不重。
我當時非常擔心他。
但他從來不告訴我那天發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
After that day, he hasn't talked to people much and doesn't go out at all.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
從那天起，他就很少跟人說話了，也完全不出門。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
I hope he tells me what happened that day.
Iromo was such a good boy...
scripts.translation:
[母親]
我希望他能告訴我那天發生了什麼。
伊羅莫以前是個多麼好的孩子啊...

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Hum.. Iromo's favorite?
Let me think...
Actually he likes all kinds of food.
He is not picky about food.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
嗯...伊羅莫喜歡吃什麼？
讓我想想...
其實他什麼食物都喜歡。
他對食物並不挑剔。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
When he went out with friends,
he spent all his pocket money,
but I don't know what he has been eating.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
以前他出去和朋友玩的時候，
總是把零花錢花光，
但我不知道他都吃了些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Oh, why don't you ask Iromo's friend?
I think he would know about his favorite food.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
哦，你為什麼不問問伊羅莫的朋友呢？
我想他應該知道伊羅莫喜歡吃什麼。

scripts.translation:

我想他應該知道伊羅莫喜歡吃什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
This little boy is my son, Iromo.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
這個小男孩就是我的兒子，伊羅莫。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
He used to go out all the time.
He loved playing outside with friends.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
他以前總是到處跑。
他喜歡和朋友們在外面玩。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
But, somehow...
he doesn't go out anymore.
scripts.translation:
[母親]
但是，不知為什麼...
他再也不出去了。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
I am so worried about him...
What happened to him..?
scripts.translation:
[母親]
我好擔心他...
他到底怎麼了..？

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Iromo? He used to like ^FF0000Monster's Feed^000000 and ^FF0000Red Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
伊羅莫？他以前喜歡^FF0000魔物飼料^000000和^FF0000紅色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Oh ya and one more thing~!
I like Bananas. Haha.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
哦對了，還有一件事~！
我喜歡香蕉。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
......

[Little Boy]
Yummy! Banana is always delicious!
Bananas are the best fruits ever!
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
好吃！香蕉總是很美味！
香蕉是最好吃的水果！

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Thanks for the Banana...
Now I can think about
what Iromo likes to eat.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
謝謝你的香蕉...
現在我可以想想
伊羅莫喜歡吃什麼了。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
He used to like junk food.
You know, cheap and weird tasting snacks...
So he had to hide when he had them.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
他以前喜歡吃垃圾食品。
就是那種便宜又難吃的零食...
所以他吃的時候都要躲起來。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
His mother wouldn't let him
have those kind of snacks...
So he hid them from her.
I don't know why he liked
those junk foods anyways.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
他媽媽不讓他
吃那種零食...
所以他偷偷藏起來。
我不知道他為什麼
喜歡那些垃圾食品。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
He usually enjoyed having
Monster's Feed.
He said it is good
with Red Potion soup.
He always had a Red Potion and Monster's Feed for his lunch.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
他通常很喜歡吃
魔物飼料。
他說搭配紅色藥水湯很好喝。
他午餐總是吃紅色藥水和魔物飼料。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
He's got a weird appetite.
I can't understand why he liked
those foods. He was odd...
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
他的口味真奇怪。
我不明白他為什麼
喜歡那些食物。他真古怪...

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Anyway, I already told you
what I know about him.
So, I am done now.
Let me know if you have more Bananas. Haha.
I love Bananas~~!
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
總之，我已經把我知道的關於他的事都告訴你了。
我說完了。
如果你還有香蕉，記得告訴我哦。哈哈。
我超愛香蕉的~~！

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Huh? What a delicious smell!
You brought me Bananas!
Oh, thanks so much!
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
咦？好香的味道！
你帶香蕉給我了！
太感謝了！

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Let me have them first.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
讓我先吃幾口。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Chew, chew...
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
嚼嚼嚼...

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Yum Yum...
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
好吃好吃...

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Wait. Wait...
***Gulp***
just a second...
Wait.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
等等。等等...
***咕咚***
稍等一下...
等等。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Banana~banana~
I love bananas~
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
香蕉~香蕉~
我愛香蕉~

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
They don't sell bananas in this village...
I am eager to have bananas.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
這個村莊不賣香蕉...
我好想吃香蕉啊。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Oh~ you promised!
Bring bananas for me~!! I will wait for you!
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
哦~你答應我了！
給我帶香蕉來~！！我會等你的！

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
I am hungry. We don't have
much snack bar in this village.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
我餓了。這個村莊沒什麼零食店。

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Huh? Iromo?
Oh, I haven't seen him for a long time...
Hum.. Where is he?
Did he move out?
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
咦？伊羅莫？
哦，好久沒見到他了...
嗯.. 他在哪裡？
他搬走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Huh? His favorite food?.
Hum.. What was it..?
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
咦？他最喜歡的食物？
嗯.. 是什麼來著..？

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
If I can remember it can you buy me a banana?
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
如果我想起來了，你能給我買根香蕉嗎？

scripts.text:

Banana~banana~
I love bananas~
scripts.translation:

香蕉~香蕉~
我愛香蕉~

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Little Boy]
Oh, you will buy me a banana?
I'll try to remember what Iromo's favorite food is for sure if you bring it to me.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
哦，你要給我買香蕉？
只要你給我帶過來，我肯定能想起伊羅莫最喜歡吃什麼。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

I hope they sell bananas
in this village.
Like other nice villages.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
希望這個村莊能賣香蕉。
像其他不錯的村莊那樣。

scripts.text:

This village is so boring...
What a small village.
scripts.translation:
[小男孩]
這個村莊真無聊...
好小的村莊。
